notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
curl with imaps:// scheme authenticates and lists mail folders over TLS in a single command. Also exposes TLS handshake, cipher suite, server banner with version, and full CAPABILITY exchange in verbose mode (-v).

=== CHAINING ===
Confirm valid IMAP credentials (from SMTP VRFY + password reuse or other source) → curl list folders → openssl s_client for interactive session → read mail for credentials, internal IPs, sensitive data.

=== INTELLIGENCE VALUE ===
Mail content frequently contains credentials for internal systems, VPN access info, and internal IP topology. IMAP is preferred over POP3 because it retains all folders including Sent, Drafts, and custom folders.

=== CRED CHAIN ===
Username discovered via SMTP VRFY → password = username (or from password spray) → curl confirms valid IMAP creds → full mailbox accessible.
